text.title: Crown of Order
text.body: Final Chapter — Path of Order (Ending A). Inside the frozen marble cathedral of the Crown Vault, shatter the West and East Resonance Anchors with the Sigil of Order, then strike down Arch-Warden Korrath ('The Living Law') to snap the necrotic tether choking the Caldera and let a mortal world heal.
text.obj.0: Sunder both Resonance Anchor Seals (west and east)
text.obj.1: Defeat Arch-Warden Korrath inside the Crown Vault
text.msg.1: Korrath is the eternal warden of a dead empire, his flesh turned to petrified granite by three centuries of unbroken vigil. He believes the only cure for mortal suffering is to freeze the world in stone forever. Sunder the twin resonance anchors flanking the vault—or his blades will execute us in the name of eternal silence!
text.msg.2: The West Resonance Anchor fractures under the Sigil of Order!
text.msg.3: The East Resonance Anchor shatters—Korrath's invulnerable ward collapses!
text.msg.4: Three centuries I have stood in granite silence to hold chaos at bay. You shatter anchors and call it mercy, yet without iron law, mortals are only dust in the wind!
text.msg.5: The empire was peace... without stone... you are only... dust...
text.win: Arch-Warden Korrath dissolves into gray dust, snapping the necrotic tether so the Caldera cools and Thornvael greets a living dawn.
text.fail.1: Your hero fell inside the Crown Vault.
